disclaimer: Predictions are falsifiers for the framework. They do not prove LENR occurs.

predictions.title: Heat-helium correlation ratio
predictions.falsifier: He-4/heat ratio differs from predicted value by > factor of 10 across independent experiments

predictions.title: Neutron energy spectrum and detector-interpretation gates
predictions.observable: Peak near 2.45 MeV with FWHM > 100 keV; flux < 1e3 n/s per ~1 W; Cd-ratio / moderator-null / soft-X∧¬hard-γ consistency with a thermal-neutron reading
predictions.falsifier: Sharp 2.45 MeV peak with no broadening; or no neutrons above background at >5 sigma for >100 hours; or Cd-wrapped high counts with soft-X present and hard-γ absent (non-neutron interpretation); or removing moderator raises counter rate (moderator-null). Cd-wrap alone is never neutron proof.

predictions.title: Gamma radiation upper bound
predictions.falsifier: Detection of 23.8 MeV gammas at rate > 1e-5 gamma/s/W

predictions.title: Tritium production rate and branching ratio
Threshold sensitivity parameters
predictions.falsifier: Excess heat reproducibly at loading < 0.85 and defect densities < 1e8 /cm3

predictions.title: Non-equilibrium BEC signatures
predictions.observable: Deuteron momentum distribution narrower than thermal at specific phonon drive frequencies
predictions.falsifier: Deuteron momentum remains purely thermal under all drive conditions

predictions.title: Activation product mass spectrum
predictions.observable: Pd-105/107 enrichment; possible Cu appearance in Ni-H
predictions.falsifier: No isotopic shifts beyond natural variation (2 sigma) after prolonged active runs

predictions.title: Cd-ratio thermal-neutron calibration
predictions.observable: Bare/Cd-wrapped SNM-14 (or equivalent) count-rate ratio consistent with thermal-neutron background suppression (~10× when Cd works)
predictions.falsifier: High Cd-wrapped counter rate with bare/Cd ratio ≪ thermal-calibration floor while claiming a slow-neutron signal. Cd-wrap high counts are a detector-interpretation issue — never treated as neutron proof.

predictions.title: Moderator-null transfer function
predictions.observable: R(with moderator)/R(bare) ≥ 1 when a thermal-neutron reading requires moderation
predictions.falsifier: Removing moderator raises the counter rate under otherwise identical geometry (moderator-null), inconsistent with a simple thermal-neutron transfer function

predictions.title: Soft-X present with hard-γ absent under Cd-wrapped counters
predictions.observable: Multi-messenger consistency: hard-γ UL, soft-X channel, and Cd-differential neutron counters agree on a neutron vs non-neutron reading
predictions.falsifier: Soft-X present ∧ hard-γ null ∧ Cd-wrapped counter high → BRANCHING_INCONSISTENT_WITH_NEUTRON_INTERPRETATION (scenario diagnostic only; never ν proof; never EQ-OPEN-EC discharge)
